thread:
Elaine: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we surfaced several items that need concrete owners: ordering of triage commands, a small eviction-check helper, and a clarified escalation ladder. Who can take which? Need owners + ETA by EoW.

Carlos: I can grab the triage command ordering and add a minimal example sequence + notes about when to escalate. ETA Thu COB.

Morgan: I'll build the eviction-check helper script and embed the cluster queries we ran. Will add a short README for on-call. Targeting Fri.

Raj: I'll rewrite the escalation path with explicit timeouts (ack expectations) and templates for paging infra vs eng-sre. Need a reviewer before merge, aiming for next Tue.

Elaine: @Carlos please include the exact log snippets we used, e.g. ```bash
kubectl logs -l app=inference --since=30m | grep -i oom
``` and when to run `redis-cli info memory` + `curl -s` to health endpoints. Also add the CPU thresholds we agreed on (sustained 95th >90% for 5m or >3 OOMs in 10m).

Carlos: Will do. I'll also add a short checklist at the top like: 1) confirm pod restarts 2) check eviction events 3) check redis memory 4) page infra if criteria met.

Morgan: Eviction helper will include this quick check: ```bash
# find eviction events in last hour
kubectl get events --field-selector reason=Evicted --since=1h -o wide | tail -n 50
``` plus `nvidia-smi` sample output parsing and a jq snippet to pull memory requests. I'll add notes about false positives during deploy spikes.

Raj: For escalation I'll draft a decision tree: Page infra-oncall -> if no ack in 10m escalate to eng-sre rotation -> open bridge and assign triage owner. Include template messages for P0 vs P1 and a DM fallback list.

Elaine: We also flagged a recurring pattern tag: "cache-eviction-after-autoscaler-spike". Suggest adding a short FAQ entry with remediations: set HPA minReplicas, disable scale-to-zero for critical pools, or increase eviction thresholds. @Morgan ok to include HPA snippet?

Morgan: Yep. I'll include an example HPA patch and a note about cost tradeoffs. Example snippet: ```yaml
spec:
  minReplicas: 2
```

Carlos: Who will review PRs? Sophia offered during the postmortem — @Sophia can you take reviews?

Sophia: I can review Carlos' and Raj's PRs. Will try to get feedback by Fri.

Elaine: Summary of actions — Carlos: triage command order + logs (Thu COB); Morgan: eviction helper + HPA FAQ (Fri); Raj: escalation decision tree + templates (next Tue); Sophia: reviewer (Fri). I'll make a tracking ticket and add links to PRs.

Elaine: Also adding a short smoke test checklist for on-call after updates: run log snippet, run eviction helper, verify pager routes, and exercise a synthetic traffic test for 5m. Add items here if you think of more.
